# Feature Specification: Officer workflow, admin tools and sign-in

**Feature Branch**: `pre-main--spec-desk-data`

**Created**: 2026-10-18 (Asia/Dhaka). Generated by Puku CLI Opus 4.8 worker for the pre-main convergence lane. Pre-main convergence desk output, not a human-approved spec.

**Status**: Draft for human skim; specification only. Derives intent from the V2 spec pack (`docs/spec/`), the actual architecture in `src/server/case/`, `src/server/admin/`, `src/server/auth/`, `src/app/(desk)/officer/case/`, `src/app/(desk)/admin/`, `src/app/(auth)/`, `src/app/not-found.tsx` and the existing `docs/execution/evidence/` documents.

**Input**: V2 pack D1 FR-016, FR-018, FR-020, FR-021, FR-025, FR-029, FR-030, FR-031, FR-035, FR-037, D2A API-005, API-010–API-013, API-016, API-017, API-018, API-020, D3 SCREEN-006, SCREEN-008, SCREEN-012, SCREEN-013, SCREEN-016, D6 TASK-006, TASK-015 (shared), TASK-022 (shared), TASK-024 (shared), TASK-025 (shared), TASK-029, TASK-031, TASK-032, TASK-049, TASK-050, BR-001, BR-005, BR-007, BR-009, BR-010, BR-012, BR-013, BR-020, BR-024, BR-025, BR-026.

**Owner**: Mahim (called Sadman in the V2 pack) for case service, state guard, audit, redaction, sign-in, not-found, admin. The convergence-desk lane only writes this spec; it does not write the officer/admin/sign-in code.

This feature covers the desk-side officer and admin lifecycle that consumes the case service: a verified officer records a confirmed pair, closes the missing case with a V2 outcome, reviews the audit log; the admin redacts eligible terminal cases, verifies officers, and (in Should) imports synthetic fixture texts; a parent may edit a confirmed missing case in Should (FR-029) and see their own case status (FR-030); SCREEN-008 sign-in, SCREEN-016 not-found and the page-denial hook are shared with all desk features. (STORY-010, STORY-012, STORY-016, STORY-017, STORY-019, STORY-020; SCREEN-006, SCREEN-008, SCREEN-012, SCREEN-013, SCREEN-016; FR-016, FR-018, FR-020, FR-021, FR-025, FR-029, FR-030, FR-031, FR-035, FR-037; BR-001, BR-005, BR-007, BR-009, BR-010, BR-012, BR-013, BR-020, BR-024, BR-025, BR-026; TASK-006, TASK-015, TASK-022, TASK-024, TASK-025, TASK-029, TASK-031, TASK-032, TASK-049, TASK-050; TC-008, TC-010, TC-011, TC-015, TC-016, TC-018, TC-019, TC-022, TC-023, TC-029, TC-031, TC-032, TC-044, TC-045, TC-046, TC-047, TC-050, TC-051, TC-052, TC-053)

## User Scenarios & Testing *(mandatory)*

Stories 1–4 support V2 Must behaviour; Stories 5–6 are the V2 Should parent edit and status; Story 7 is the sign-in / not-found / denied-access shared with all desk features. P1/P2 reflect source priorities from D1/D6; this list does not introduce a new ranking.

### User Story 1 - Confirm, refer and close an officer case (Priority: P1)

An active verified officer opens a candidate from the queue, reviews the evidence, confirms the match, and the system records the decision, voids competitors, writes the referral record (simulation), reconciles both states and appends the audit. The officer then closes the missing case with `coordination_recorded` or `resolved_outside_fera`; a stale `expected_version` is refused (E-005). (STORY-010, STORY-012; FR-016, FR-018; BR-001, BR-005, BR-012, BR-013, BR-020; SCREEN-010, SCREEN-012; API-010, API-011; TASK-028, TASK-029)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (GOAL-006, GOAL-008). The officer is the only authority for confirmation; partial or stale decisions would make both case histories misleading.

**Independent Test**: Confirm once on a known candidate, race a competing decision, attempt an illegal state jump, close with `coordination_recorded`, attempt a re-close, attempt close as a non-officer; check TC-010, TC-016, TC-029, TC-032, TC-046, TC-047, TC-051, TC-053. (D2B §10.1)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** a pending candidate and an active verified officer, **when** they confirm, **then** one transaction writes the decision, the confirmed candidate, the voided competitors, `match.confirm`, the referral record (simulation) and `referral.recorded`; the missing case moves to `confirmed` and the found case moves to `referred`. (FR-016, FR-018; BR-001, BR-005, BR-012, BR-013, BR-020; TC-010, TC-016)
2. **Given** a confirmed missing case with the referral record, **when** the officer closes with `coordination_recorded`, **then** the case is `closed`, the audit row `case.closed` carries the outcome and `reason_recorded: true`, the note is stored but never audited, and the eligible-count for redaction increases by 1. (FR-018, FR-025; BR-009, BR-012, BR-013; TC-010, TC-012, TC-015)
3. **Given** a re-close attempt, **when** the officer closes again, **then** the request is refused (E-005) and no new audit row is written. (BR-012, BR-013; TC-029, TC-032)
4. **Given** a non-officer or unverified-officer attempting close, **when** the request is made, **then** the request is refused (E-004) and `access.denied` is written. (BR-007, BR-024; TC-022, TC-052)
5. **Given** an officer case-detail page, **when** it loads, **then** the missing and found reports are shown side by side with their current states, the audit log, the eligible-count for redaction (admin only), and the synthetic / [MOCK] chips. (BR-007, BR-024; TC-019, TC-045)

---

### User Story 2 - Append-only audit, contact view and denial events (Priority: P1)

Every state change, decision, edit, redaction, contact view and denied access is recorded as an append-only audit event. The audit log is the only source for a guardian authority claim; the case service refuses an action whose audit row cannot be written. UPDATE, DELETE and TRUNCATE on the audit table are rejected, and the runtime role has no DDL. (STORY-017; FR-021; BR-009, BR-010; NFR-010; SCREEN-012; API-013; TASK-015, TASK-029)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (Constitution V, BR-009, BR-010). A failed audit aborts the action; the audit log is the only way to defend later claims.

**Independent Test**: Force a denied action, force a contact view, force a decision, force a redaction; check TC-016, TC-029, TC-046, TC-047, TC-051, TC-052, TC-053. (D2B §10.1)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** an officer reading a candidate with another party's phone, **when** the response is served, **then** `case.contact_viewed` is written in the same transaction; a failed write fails closed (E-021). (FR-021; BR-010; TC-051)
2. **Given** a denied API request (E-003, E-004, E-005, E-021), **when** the response is returned, **then** `access.denied` is written with the error id and the API name, the case FK is null when the case is unknown, and a failed write fails closed (E-021). (FR-021; BR-007, BR-010, BR-024; TC-016, TC-052)
3. **Given** the audit log on the case-detail page, **when** it is requested, **then** the log shows the actions, the actor role, the timestamp (UTC + Asia/Dhaka), the case FK, the candidate FK (when relevant) and the typed details only; no free text, no child name, no phone, no description. (FR-021; BR-009, BR-010; NFR-010; TC-016, TC-019)
4. **Given** an attempt to UPDATE, DELETE or TRUNCATE the audit table, **when** the SQL is issued, **then** it is rejected by the database and the runtime role has no DDL. (BR-010; NFR-010; TC-016)

---

### User Story 3 - Admin redaction of eligible terminal cases (Priority: P1)

A redactor admin opens SCREEN-013, sees the eligible count (closed missing + referred found with the missing report also closed), reads the three honest facts (pseudonymisation, not full anonymisation; copies outside Fera not removed; found evidence kept until its missing report closes), types the typed-confirmation word "বেনামী" and presses the soft-danger button. The server redacts the eligible pair, writes `case.payload_redacted` per case, and the audit details carry only the mode and the `external_copies_removed` flag. (STORY-016; FR-025; BR-009, BR-010, BR-024; SCREEN-013; API-016; TASK-032)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (Safeguarding, BR-009). Redaction is the only path that clears direct and related identifying payloads from eligible terminal reports; active linked evidence is kept.

**Independent Test**: Seed 3 closed/referred reports (1 eligible pair, 1 active pair with confirmed but unclosed missing, 1 open) and 1 open; redact `all_eligible: true`; assert 2 redacted, 1 skipped, mode `pseudonymisation`, `external_copies_removed: false`; assert the active pair and the open report keep their payload; assert the referral note and candidate reason are `[REDACTED]` on the eligible pair, untouched on the active pair. (TC-015, TC-050)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** an eligible pair (closed missing + referred found with the missing report also closed), **when** the admin confirms the typed word "বেনামী" and submits, **then** both cases are redacted, both `case.payload_redacted` audit rows are written by the admin, the eligible count becomes 0, and a repeat run gives `{ redacted: 0, skipped_not_eligible: 1 }`. (FR-025; BR-009, BR-010; TC-015)
2. **Given** an active pair (confirmed missing not yet closed), **when** the admin runs redaction, **then** the pair is skipped, the missing and found reports keep their payload, and the audit log records the skip. (FR-025; BR-009; TC-015)
3. **Given** the redaction form, **when** the typed word does not match, **then** the submit is refused (inline error, `aria-invalid`) and no redaction is performed. (FR-025; BR-009, BR-024; TC-015)
4. **Given** a non-admin attempting API-016, **when** the request is made, **then** the request is refused (E-003) and `access.denied` is written. (BR-007, BR-024; TC-022, TC-052)
5. **Given** the redaction rate limit (`adminRedaction` 5/min per principal), **when** the 6th request is made in a minute, **then** the request is refused (E-007) and the response fails closed. (OD-032-4)

---

### User Story 4 - Admin verify-officers and synthetic import (Priority: P1 + Should)

A redactor admin opens SCREEN-013, lists officer accounts (verified, not verified, inactive), toggles the verified flag (the `[MOCK]` simulation note stays visible), and the system writes `user.verification_changed` audit. The synthetic fixture import (FR-024) is a planned extension labelled "পরিকল্পিত"; the form is not submittable to a live endpoint. (STORY-015, STORY-016; FR-024, FR-035, FR-037; BR-007, BR-024, BR-026; SCREEN-013; API-017, API-021, API-015; TASK-032, TASK-048)

**Why this priority**: Must (verify-officers) and Should (import). Verification controls who can record a decision; the synthetic import is gated on the FR-024 spec.

**Independent Test**: With an admin session, list users, toggle an officer's verified flag, assert the response and the audit; a non-admin is refused (E-003). The import panel is visible and labelled but its API returns 501 / E-019. (TC-022, TC-023, TC-035, TC-014)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** an admin session, **when** they list users, **then** the response carries only `id, username, display_name, role, verified, is_active`; no phone, no email, no name beyond the display name. (FR-037, FR-035; BR-007, BR-024; TC-022, TC-023, TC-045)
2. **Given** an admin session, **when** they toggle an officer's verified flag, **then** the toggle is written with `user.verification_changed` audit; a second toggle with the same value writes nothing; a forged HMAC cursor is E-001. (FR-035; BR-010, BR-024; TC-023; OD-032-7)
3. **Given** the synthetic fixture import panel, **when** it loads, **then** it shows the "পরিকল্পিত" label and the API returns 501 / E-019 with no record written. (FR-024, FR-026; OQ-003; TC-014, TC-035)

---

### User Story 5 - Parent edits a confirmed missing case (Priority: P2)

A parent opens their own case on SCREEN-006, edits a reviewed field, and the system locks the neighbourhood, writes a `case_versions` snapshot, voids the pending candidates, re-queues matching, clears the embedding, and writes `case.edited` with the `fields_changed` paths only. A terminal or redacted report is E-018; a stale `expected_version` is E-005. (STORY-019; FR-029; BR-012, BR-013, BR-025; SCREEN-006; API-005; TASK-049)

**Why this priority**: Should requirement (GOAL-Support). A parent can correct a detail without losing the prior version; pending candidates are voided and re-issued.

**Independent Test**: With a parent session, edit a missing case; assert the new version, the voided candidates, the `case.edited` audit and the `fields_changed` paths. (TC-018, TC-029)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** a parent session and a confirmed missing case, **when** they edit a reviewed field, **then** the new version is written, the prior version is preserved, the pending candidates are voided (`match.voided` on the other endpoint), matching is re-queued and the embedding is cleared. (FR-029; BR-012, BR-019, BR-025; TC-018)
2. **Given** a terminal or redacted report, **when** the parent edits, **then** the request is refused (E-018) and no version is written. (FR-029; BR-025; TC-018)
3. **Given** a stale `expected_version`, **when** the parent edits, **then** the request is refused (E-005) and the parent is offered to reload. (FR-029; BR-012; TC-029)
4. **Given** a non-owner edit attempt, **when** the request is made, **then** the request is refused (E-004) and `access.denied` is written. (BR-007, BR-024; TC-022, TC-052)

---

### User Story 6 - Parent sees their own case status (Priority: P2)

A parent opens SCREEN-006, sees the missing case's current state, the matched-candidate banner (without candidate detail), the authorised edit and output availability, and a "no candidate details" notice. (STORY-020; FR-030; BR-007, BR-024; SCREEN-006; API-018; TASK-050)

**Why this priority**: Should requirement (GOAL-Support). The parent sees their own case and status; the officer projection and the candidate list stay officer-only.

**Independent Test**: With a parent session, read API-018; assert the response carries the missing case's state, the matched-candidate banner, no candidate detail and no other-party evidence. (TC-019, TC-022)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** a parent session, **when** they read API-018, **then** the response carries the missing case's state, the matched-candidate banner, the authorised edit and output availability, no candidate detail and no other-party evidence. (FR-030; BR-007, BR-024; TC-019, TC-022, TC-045)
2. **Given** a parent whose missing case is `closed`, **when** they read API-018, **then** the response shows the closure outcome (`coordination_recorded` or `resolved_outside_fera`) and the eligible-count for redaction is hidden (admin-only). (FR-030; BR-009, BR-024; TC-015, TC-019)
3. **Given** a non-owner read attempt, **when** the request is made, **then** the request is refused (E-004) and `access.denied` is written with a null FK. (BR-007, BR-010, BR-024; TC-022, TC-052)

---

### User Story 7 - Sign-in, not-found and the page-denial hook (Priority: P1)

A staff member, verified officer or admin signs in on SCREEN-008 and reaches the workspace permitted by their role; a parent starts without an account and can access only their own case. An unverified officer has staff permissions only. A wrong-role page visit writes one `access.denied` row and renders SCREEN-016 with a 404, not a 500. The frame is denied (X-Frame-Options: DENY, CSP frame-ancestors 'none'). (STORY-008, STORY-009; FR-020, FR-035, FR-037; BR-007, BR-010, BR-024; SCREEN-008, SCREEN-016; API-020; TASK-006, TASK-031)

**Why this priority**: Must requirement (Constitution III, BR-007). Role visibility and not-found uniformity are the foundation of every other desk feature.

**Independent Test**: With synthetic role accounts and a parent session, exercise sign-in, permitted own-case reads, candidate requests, decision requests, a wrong-role page visit and a stale session; check TC-022, TC-023, TC-044, TC-052. (D2B §13)

**Acceptance Scenarios**:

1. **Given** a staff or unverified-officer account, **when** it requests candidate evidence or a decision, **then** access is refused and no candidate or other-party payload appears. (FR-020, FR-035; BR-007, BR-024; TC-022, TC-023)
2. **Given** an active verified officer, **when** that officer opens an authorised operational case, **then** the officer-only view is available; an admin receives metadata and aggregates without candidate IDs, scores or child payload. (BR-007, BR-024; TC-044, TC-045)
3. **Given** an absent or hidden case, **when** a signed-in user requests it, **then** the same not-found response appears and a safe denied-access audit event is recorded without disclosing whether the case exists. (BR-007, BR-010; SCREEN-016; TC-022, TC-052)
4. **Given** an expired credential session, **when** the user requests a protected screen, **then** sign-in is requested and the intended URL can be resumed after authentication only when the resumed URL's first segment matches the role home's. (SCREEN-008; E-002; D3 §6; OD-031-7)
5. **Given** a wrong-role page visit, **when** the request is made, **then** `access.denied` is written and the user is sent to SCREEN-016 with a 404. (BR-007, BR-010, BR-024; SCREEN-016; TC-022, TC-052)
6. **Given** any route, **when** it is served, **then** `X-Frame-Options: DENY` and `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none'` are present. (BR-007)

---

### Edge Cases

- The eligibility check for redaction is shared between the page and the API; the API and the page never disagree. (FR-025; BR-009)
- A redaction form submission is rate-limited (`adminRedaction` 5/min per principal); a 6th submission in a minute is refused (E-007) and never auto-closes. (OD-032-4)
- A verify-officer toggle with the same value writes nothing; a forged HMAC cursor is E-001. (OD-032-3, OD-032-7)
- A parent edit after the case is terminal or redacted is E-018; the prior version is preserved. (FR-029; BR-025)
- A sign-in form on a 320 CSS px / 200 % text zoom screen has no horizontal scroll; every control is ≥ 44 px. (TASK-034; NFR-011, NFR-013; D4)
- A sign-in attempt with E-002 clears the password and refocuses it; a 429 / E-007 reads the `Retry-After` header in whole seconds, with Bangla numerals in Bangla mode. (D2B §13; OD-031-1)
- A page view of SCREEN-016 by a signed-out user shows the Paper surface and the home link to `/`; a desk role shows the Cockpit surface and its D3 home. (D3 §7; OD-031-3)
- A wrong-role page visit never reveals whether the case exists; the not-found envelope is the same. (BR-007, BR-010; SCREEN-016)

## Requirements *(mandatory)*

### Scope and boundaries

Feature 005 owns the desk-side officer and admin lifecycle work mapped to TASK-006 (auth), TASK-015 (case service and state guard — shared with feature 001), TASK-022 (review screen — shared with feature 002), TASK-024 (outputs PNG — shared with feature 003), TASK-025 (manual form — shared with feature 003), TASK-029, TASK-031, TASK-032, TASK-049, TASK-050. It consumes behaviour built in features 001–004 and changes none of their requirements. Fixes found here go to the officer/admin/sign-in owner under AGENTS ownership. Every record is invented and synthetic; no real child, photo, face, alert, physical return, police or CID integration, or legal-compliance claim is in scope. (BR-002, BR-006, BR-026)

### Functional Requirements

- **TASK-006; FR-037**: Auth.js credentials; seeded `staff.demo`, `officer.demo`, `officer.pending` and the fixed `admin.demo`; a parent has no account (anonymous cookie); the verify flag is `[MOCK]` for seeded accounts. (BR-007, BR-024; TC-023)
- **TASK-015 (shared); FR-016, FR-018, FR-021; BR-001, BR-005, BR-012, BR-013, BR-020**: The case service one-transaction confirm protocol locks both endpoints in sorted UUID order, rechecks versions, voids competitors, writes the decision, the referral record (simulation), reconciles both states and appends the audit. A failed audit aborts the action. (D2B §10.1; TC-010, TC-016, TC-029, TC-032, TC-046, TC-047, TC-051, TC-053)
- **TASK-015 (shared); FR-021; BR-010; NFR-010**: Audit logger accepts only contract codes; `details` is typed (no free text); the actor is `actorFor(principal)` or `SYSTEM_ACTOR`; the `at` is the database clock; only UUID request IDs are stored. (TC-016, TC-051, TC-052)
- **TASK-029; FR-018, FR-025; BR-009, BR-012, BR-013, BR-024**: API-011 closes a missing case with `coordination_recorded` (requires confirmed + referral) or `resolved_outside_fera` (requires open); refuses re-close; refuses non-officer; `case.closed` audit row carries the outcome and `reason_recorded: true`. (TC-010, TC-012, TC-015, TC-029, TC-032)
- **TASK-031; FR-020, FR-037; BR-007, BR-010, BR-024**: SCREEN-008 sign-in, SCREEN-016 not-found and the page-denial hook; `X-Frame-Options: DENY` and `Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'none'` on every route; a wrong-role page visit writes `access.denied` with the error id only and shows SCREEN-016 with a 404. (D2B §13; TC-022, TC-052)
- **TASK-032; FR-025, FR-035; BR-009, BR-010, BR-024**: SCREEN-013 admin redaction + verify-officers + synthetic import slot; API-016/017/021 with the typed-confirmation word "বেনামী" for redaction; `[MOCK]` simulation note on every verified-flag toggle; dashed "পরিকল্পিত" panel for the synthetic import. (TC-015, TC-022, TC-023, TC-014, TC-035)
- **TASK-049; FR-029; BR-012, BR-013, BR-025**: SCREEN-006 parent edit + API-005; the parent is the owner; the prior version is preserved; pending candidates are voided; matching is re-queued; the embedding is cleared; terminal or redacted reports are E-018; a stale `expected_version` is E-005. (TC-018, TC-029)
- **TASK-050; FR-030; BR-007, BR-024**: API-018 returns the parent projection only; no candidate detail; no other-party evidence; the eligible-count for redaction is admin-only. (TC-019, TC-022, TC-045)

### Key Entities

- **Case service commands**: `createCase`, `editCase`, `decideCandidate`, `closeCase`, `readCase`, `redactCases`, `setOfficerVerified`, `listUsers`, `readMyCase`. (TASK-015, TASK-029, TASK-032, TASK-050; FR-016, FR-018, FR-021, FR-025, FR-029, FR-030, FR-035)
- **Audit (append-only)**: `id, actor_id, actor_role, action, case_fk?, candidate_fk?, details (typed), at`. UPDATE / DELETE / TRUNCATE rejected; the runtime role has no DDL. (TASK-015; FR-021; BR-010; NFR-010; TC-016)
- **Decision**: `id, candidate_id, actor_id, kind (confirm|reject), reason_bn?, reason_en?, decided_at`. (TASK-028; FR-016, FR-017)
- **Referral (simulation)**: `id, pair_id, missing_case_id, found_case_id, recorded_by, recorded_at`. (TASK-028; BR-005; FR-016, FR-018)
- **User (admin projection)**: `id, username, display_name, role, verified, is_active`. No phone, no email, no name beyond the display name. (TASK-032; FR-035, FR-037; BR-007, BR-024; TC-022, TC-023, TC-045)
- **Case version**: `id, case_id, version, payload, edited_at, edited_by`. Preserved across edits. (TASK-049; FR-029; BR-025)
- **Redaction audit**: `case.payload_redacted` with details `{ mode, external_copies_removed }` only. (TASK-032; FR-025; BR-009, BR-010; TC-015)

## Success Criteria *(mandatory)*

### Measurable Outcomes

These are acceptance targets for the officer workflow, admin tools and sign-in. None is an achieved result at specification time.

- **SC-001**: Confirm and Reject on the same candidate with a competing request yields one decision row, one referral record (simulation), one `match.confirm` and `referral.recorded` audit, and one refused second request. (TASK-015, TASK-028; FR-016; BR-012, BR-020; TC-010, TC-016, TC-029)
- **SC-002**: Close with `coordination_recorded` works only from a confirmed case with a referral; `resolved_outside_fera` works only from an open case; re-close is refused. (TASK-029; FR-018; BR-012, BR-013; TC-010, TC-029)
- **SC-003**: Redaction of an eligible pair redacts both cases, writes two `case.payload_redacted` audit rows, sets `anonymised_at`, and never touches an active pair or an open report. (TASK-032; FR-025; BR-009; TC-015, TC-050)
- **SC-004**: A non-admin attempting API-016 / API-017 / API-021 is refused (E-003) and writes `access.denied`; a forged HMAC cursor is E-001. (TASK-032; FR-037; BR-007, BR-024; TC-022, TC-023)
- **SC-005**: A sign-in form on a 320 CSS px / 200 % text zoom screen has no horizontal scroll, every control is ≥ 44 px, and a 429 / E-007 reads the `Retry-After` header in whole seconds, with Bangla numerals in Bangla mode. (TASK-031, TASK-034; FR-037; NFR-011, NFR-013; D2B §13; D4)
- **SC-006**: A wrong-role page visit writes `access.denied` and shows SCREEN-016 with a 404, not a 500. (TASK-031; BR-007, BR-010, BR-024; SCREEN-016; TC-022, TC-052)
- **SC-007**: A parent edit on a confirmed missing case writes a new version, voids the pending candidates, re-queues matching, clears the embedding and writes `case.edited` with the `fields_changed` paths only. (TASK-049; FR-029; BR-012, BR-019, BR-025; TC-018, TC-029)
- **SC-008**: A parent read on API-018 carries the missing case's state, the matched-candidate banner, no candidate detail and no other-party evidence. (TASK-050; FR-030; BR-007, BR-024; TC-019, TC-022, TC-045)

## Assumptions, dependencies and open decisions

- **Upstream dependencies**: TASK-001 (repo), TASK-002 (DB), TASK-007 (API envelope), TASK-008 (layout), TASK-012 (normaliser), TASK-061 (contracts), TASK-026 (found log), TASK-027 (queue) and TASK-028 (match review) from features 001–004 gate this feature (D6 §5).
- **Owner**: TASK-006 (auth), TASK-015 (case service), TASK-029 (case detail/close/audit), TASK-031 (sign-in/not-found), TASK-032 (admin), TASK-049 (parent edit), TASK-050 (parent status) are Mahim's owned code. The convergence desk does not modify them.

## Notes

- The convergence desk writes this spec; **no application code** is modified. The existing case service, sign-in, not-found, admin and parent edit code is the spec-kit evidence. Owner-area changes are out of scope.
- "Buildable" means "can be implemented, tested and merged by a lane without waiting on organiser or human evidence." The buildable task board is in [plan.md](plan.md) and [tasks.md](tasks.md).
- This spec keeps the V2 spec pack and the constitution as the only sources of intent; the spec-kit artifacts record the convergence lane's view, not a rewrite of the pack.
